tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of The Korean Today articles, newest first. Korean keywords work best for the Korean edition; use lang for another edition or to get translated summaries.

tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: Most recent articles, optionally by section and language.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text and metadata of one article by id or URL. With lang, also returns the AI summary in that language and links to other language editions. Members-only articles return metadata only.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: News sections with slugs and article counts.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Language editions with their own articles, and the 87 languages with AI summaries.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_news" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_article" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get one article by id as plain text, truncated (default 3000 chars, max 8000) with a link to read the full article at the source." → after: "Full text and metadata of one article by id or URL. With lang, also returns the AI summary in that language and links to other language editions. Members-only articles return metadata only."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
